top_story.headline: Nothing major in this window; Rep. Michael T. McCaul's annual disclosure arrived 62 days late
top_story.dek: The only notable item is a late CY2025 annual financial disclosure from Rep. Michael T. McCaul (R-TX-10).
paragraphs: No new FARA filings, financial disclosures, stock-trade reports or top-official contacts came in for this window. The Office of Government Ethics filing system showed 15 filings in the past three days, all previously reported.

The one item of note comes from the Deadline Watch: Rep. Michael T. McCaul (R-TX-10) filed his CY2025 annual disclosure on 10/14/2026, 62 days after the final extension date. That makes it a late disclosure.
The lda.gov service returned HTTP 503 errors during this run, so no lobbying data was available. The absence of LDA items below reflects the outage, not a verified lack of filings.

The Office of Government Ethics section reported no new filings in this window.
